agreement.terms: Mateo offers 1 Hour Conversational Spanish in exchange for Jordan adjusting brake calipers and rear gear cable.

messages.text: Hola Jordan! I saw you have some bike repair experience. Are you still interested in exchanging Spanish conversational practice?
Hey Mateo! Yes, absolutely. I have all the hex wrenches and cable pullers. We can adjust the calipers and cable tension easily in 45 minutes!
¡Estupendo! I proposed a formal SkillSwap agreement for Saturday at 11am in Dolores Park. Feel free to review and accept whenever you're ready.
Hi Jordan! Sourdough Bubbles is ready for a new home. How large are your Monstera pots?

reviews.comment: Mateo is so patient and encouraging! We met at the library cafe. My conversational confidence improved in just one afternoon.
